featured_reviews.review_text:
Hansraj Jivandas College of Education is truly one of the finest institutions for anyone who dreams of becoming a professional, confident, and compassionate teacher. featured_reviews.name: Namrata Nayar
featured_reviews.review_text:
What should have been a review has become a eulogy, as I was just informed that Dr. Sampat is no more.

A great principal isn’t just a leader; they are a force. They shape minds, build character, and leave a mark so deep that even years later, their words echo in your heart.

Dr. Urmi Sampat was that kind of principal. She wasn’t just an educator,she was an institution.

I still remember my first day at H.J. College. She stood at the gate in a crisp cream saree, radiating authority yet warmth. “What’s your name?” she asked. “Namrata  , and I’m am going to be the topper this year,” I replied with pride. She just laughed and said, “Go and sit yourself inside.” That was Dr. Sampat, no fuss, no unnecessary praise, just straight to the point. But in that moment, she acknowledged me. And with her, an acknowledgment always meant something.

She had this aura about her,if she caught you in the corridor, you’d hold your breath. If you were exhaling, you wouldn’t dare inhale again until she passed. That was the kind of presence she had. But beneath that formidable exterior was someone who truly believed in her students.

I remember struggling in my psychology paper. She called me in and asked, “What the hell have you done?” I admitted, “I had a blackout.” She didn’t let me off easily. “I don’t believe in blackouts, but I believe in you,” she said. And that belief changed me. I promised her I wouldn’t let her down. And when I topped my methods, she awarded me the prestigious Miss H.J Title of the year. That moment shaped my future in ways I didn’t even realise at the time.

One of the greatest compliments I’ve ever received came from her:

Personally, I see a junior Dr. Urmi Sampat in Namrata.
That comparison still humbles me.

Everything she taught me stayed with me. From my first lesson at NPKT to my journey as a teacher at Arya Vidya Mandir Bandra, to moving to Dubai , her words have never left me. The discipline, the passion, the high standards,they are woven into the way I lead today.

I wish I had the chance to say goodbye. But in a way, someone like her never truly leaves. Somewhere, I know she’s making sure everyone arrives on time, does their job well, and carries themselves with the grace and dignity she expected of us all.

Dr. Sampat, you were the epitome of grace, excellence, and discipline. They don’t make them like you anymore. I treasured you, and I always will.
Yours truly,
Namrata Simon Nayar

I spent five wonderful years at this college, and this is my honest review. When I took admission, I had never even seen the college building—I joined purely based on trust and feedback. Looking back today, I can confidently say it was the right decision.
Over these five years, I not only focused on my studies but also truly enjoyed my college life. While some students choose to bunk lectures, there are many dedicated teachers here who teach with full commitment and always support students whenever they face academic difficulties.

The college offers various activities to make student life engaging and enjoyable. I was a part of NSS, and my favorite teachers were Meenakshi Ma’am and Raj Paul Sir. During my degree years, the teaching staff felt more like friends than strict professors. We never skipped lectures, and even when we attended lectures of other divisions, the teachers were always welcoming and understanding.

A college should not be judged based on the behavior of a few students. My personal experience here has been extremely positive. If you choose to learn while enjoying the journey, this college and its teachers will never disappoint you.

Also, a special mention—the best samosas and Schezwan I’ve ever had were here! This place truly felt like home to me.

Forever grateful to this college.
— A proud ex-student

From the very first day, the atmosphere of the department felt positive and inspiring. The campus environment encourages students to focus on learning while also exploring their own potential. The classrooms and laboratories are well maintained, creating a perfect balance between theoretical and practical learning. The department believes in the principle that education is not just about passing exams, but about preparing students for real-life responsibilities.

The teaching and learning process in the department is systematic and student-oriented. Each subject is taught with clarity and relevance to real-world applications. The teachers use various teaching methods such as presentations, demonstrations, discussions, and problem-solving sessions. This helps students understand complex topics easily. As the saying goes, “Tell me and I forget, teach me and I remember, involve me and I learn.”
The laboratory sessions play a crucial role in pharmacy education, and the department excels in this area. The labs are well equipped with necessary instruments and materials. Practical sessions help students connect theory with practice. Performing experiments, preparing formulations, and learning laboratory techniques make students confident and competent. These experiences help us understand that “knowledge without practice is incomplete.”

One of the strongest pillars of the department is its faculty members. They are highly qualified, experienced, and approachable. Their dedication towards students is truly commendable. They not only teach from books but also share their personal experiences, which makes learning more meaningful. Teachers act not only as instructors but also as mentors and motivators. Whenever students face academic or personal challenges, the faculty provides guidance and emotional support. Truly, they believe that “a good teacher can change a life.”

“Every setback is a setup for a comeback” became my personal motto.

The friendships I made here, the guidance I received, and the experiences I gained will always remain close to my heart. The department became my second home, where I learned not only academic lessons but also life lessons. It taught me patience, perseverance, and professionalism.
Thank you SNDT

My daughter is currently studying in the Second Year BAMMC program at St. Paul College, and our experience has been very positive. The college provides a supportive learning environment with knowledgeable and approachable faculty members who encourage students to develop both academic and practical skills.

The BAMMC curriculum is well-structured and offers opportunities for creativity, communication, and media-related learning. The college also organizes various activities, workshops, and events that help students gain confidence and real-world exposure.

The campus atmosphere is friendly, disciplined, and focused on overall student development. The teaching staff is dedicated and always willing to guide students in their academic journey.

I am happy with my daughter's progress and would recommend St. Paul College to students looking for quality education and holistic growth in the field of media and communication.

featured_reviews.name: Reanne
featured_reviews.review_text: St Pauls College for Women in Bandra West is definitely a great place to study media! The faculty is super understanding, supportive and obliging. They are industry professionals, hence are able to guide and help with whatever doubts you may have. Consisting of a mix of both theoretical and practical studying which makes the whole experience on campus very engaging. They also have great facilities and infrastructure like a professional TV studio, podcast studio, editing suites, computer labs and AC smart classrooms that make coming to college fun and interesting! They focus individually on their students and cater to their needs and interests and provide opportunities accordingly. If you’re someone creative who likes to think outside the box and want a career in multimedia and mass communication, you’re definitely at the right place!

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Sinha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Completing my Post Graduate Advanced Diploma in Advertising and Marketing at St. Paul's Institute (Bandra West) has been one of the most enriching experiences of my academic life.

Some places teach you a subject. This course taught me how to think; about brands, consumers, human behaviour. What sets this institute apart is the exceptional calibre of its faculty. We weren't just encouraged to ask questions, but to ask the right ones. All the modules undertaken were relevant, insightful and instilled a sense of critical thinking.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Ramachandran Srinivasan (Programme Director), who always had every student's back whether for academic guidance, personal growth, or professional networking.

The institute also offers PG programmes in Journalism, Public Relations, and Filmmaking. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to build a career in these fields.

featured_reviews.name: Zenia Simon
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience attending the Summer Workshop for Graphic Designing. It was very informative and helped me learn many new design skills and creative techniques.

A special thanks to Mr. Manish Mhatre for his excellent guidance and teaching. He explained concepts clearly and made the sessions engaging and enjoyable.

Overall, it was a valuable learning experience, and I would highly recommend this workshop to anyone interested in graphic design.

featured_reviews.name: Vincent De Souza
featured_reviews.review_text: I have just completed my PG Diploma in Public Relations from St.Paul's. For those thinking about whether you should apply for this course or not, let me tell you a few differentiating factors that make this course unique from others. 1) You have working professionals who come with many years of Industrial experience, so the knowledge you obtain is up-to-date. 2) They don't just teach you theory but give you practical experience in the field. 3) You get placements through the college once you've completed the course. 4) Another unique thing this college does is that it doesn't just teach me about Public Relations, but also about advertising, filmmaking and journalism as well, so it's an all-around development for a professional in this day and age. 5) The environment of this college has prepared me to deal with almost any situation I might face in the industry. It has also helped me develop my leadership skills, and thanks to that, I've led various events and projects. I hope this is helpful. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Satya Tirtharaj Ghosal
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best thing about this college is that they ask the students, what they want to learn and curating the course accordingly. Most faculty members of St. Pauls are from the industry under their guidance and mentorship you will excel in your work, as most of assignment would be similar to actual work in jobs. They offer internships, in areas, the students are truly passionate about. Allowing us to gain real world experience. They support every endeavour which allows you to be better.

featured_reviews.name: Gopika
featured_reviews.review_text: I am currently pursuing my PG diploma in advertising and marketing. This institute makes sure their curriculum is modern and contemporary. They really focus on providing skills that is relevant. They have a non conventional approach to teaching, where they bring in speakers from the industry to give the students a full view into their world. They are always open to feedbacks from students, which i personally found very helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Sarvesh Pingle
featured_reviews.review_text: Ftii workshop was a great experience in terms of knowledge and hands on experience related to the multicamera setup of TV production shows. The filmmaking course at St Paul's is a great course for beginners, faculty are great and the course has enough modules to give you an overview knowledge about the complete process of filmmaking.

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Niphadkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently was part of the IEEE Techithon 2026 event organized by Atharva University Mumbai at Malad Campus from 28th to 30th January 2026. There was participation from different colleges from across country and students displayed their projects in form of proto types and applications which addressed some of the social causes as well. Use of Robotics, AI and Satellite communication initiatives were demonstrated by students which really were an inspiration for all generations. Founder Shri Sunil Rane Sir, was actively participating at the event and encouraging these young minds and lifting their morale to motivate them to make in India and also fund their projects and aspirations through Atharva University Mumbai's incubation Centre. Atharva University Mumbai has a state of art Campus with latest technology infrastructure to enable students to take up research and development of new projects and initiatives under the guidance of Shri Sunil Rane Sir and team of competent Engineering and Technology faculty members who along with the students made this event a grand success. Wishing all the young minds all the best wishes and Congratulations to Atharva University Mumbai for hosting this successful event. Jai Hind.

featured_reviews.name: Rita Pal
featured_reviews.review_text: The IEEE TECHITHON 26 organized at Atharva University, Mumbai was a well-structured and professionally conducted technical event. It effectively provided students with an opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge to practical problem-solving while fostering innovation and teamwork. The systematic organization and academic guidance contributed significantly to the success of the event. Overall, the initiative reflects the university’s commitment to academic excellence and technical skill development.

featured_reviews.name: Tanmay
featured_reviews.review_text: As a student of Atharva College of Engineering, I feel the college provides a good balance between academics and extracurricular activities. The faculty members are helpful and supportive, especially during projects and exams, and the campus infrastructure is quite modern and well-maintained. The college also conducts technical events, workshops, and placement training sessions that help students improve their practical knowledge and career opportunities. Although attendance and academic rules are a bit strict, the overall environment is positive and motivating for students who want to grow academically and professionally.

featured_reviews.name: Hardik Suvare
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m really happy with my experience at Atharva University. The campus environment is positive and student-friendly, and the faculty members are supportive and helpful throughout academics. The university provides good opportunities for skill development, workshops, and placements. The infrastructure, classrooms, and labs are well maintained, creating a comfortable learning atmosphere. Overall, it has been a good place for academic growth and gaining practical exposure.

featured_reviews.name: Shriya Salunkhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Atharva University provides an excellent learning environment with modern infrastructure, skilled faculty, and strong industry-focused programs. The emphasis on practical learning, innovation, and emerging technologies helps students stay future-ready. Faculty members are supportive and encourage hands-on learning through projects and real-world applications.

The IEEE Techithon 2026 at Atharva University, held from 28–30 January 2026, was an exciting, well-organized technical fest and project exhibition. The three-day event featured enthusiastic participation from students and tech enthusiasts with activities like hackathons, robotics showcases, drone demonstrations, and innovative project exhibitions. Workshops and sessions highlighted emerging technologies and provided great learning opportunities.

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Rathore
featured_reviews.review_text: Atharva University in Malad is hands down one of the best campuses in Mumbai! The infrastructure is modern, spacious, and very well-maintained, creating a fantastic student environment. The faculty members are extremely supportive, highly knowledgeable, and always ready to guide you through both academics and projects. Truly a great place to learn and grow! Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Pawaskar
featured_reviews.review_text: Atharva University has a very good campus environment with modern infrastructure and well-maintained classrooms. The location is convenient and the overall atmosphere feels energetic and student-friendly. I really liked how the university organizes various cultural activities, seminars, events, and extracurricular programs that help students grow beyond academics. The campus vibe, facilities, and active student life make it a great place for learning and personal development

featured_reviews.name: Karan Sapalia
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at Atharva has been amazing so far. Campus life here is top-notch—fests like Rhythm and IEEE Techithon are the highlights of the year. The crowd is diverse, and there’s a real focus on holistic growth beyond just textbooks. The location in Malad is convenient with the metro nearby. If you’re looking for a college that balances academics with great extracurriculars, this is it!
